note: build-from-deck 0.5.0: five stages, each one skill (pipeline.json "skills"). A runner stage "uses" <alias>:<STEP> of a pinned skill; its commands come from the skill's skill.json and run in the skill's folder. "stage" groups jobs into S1…S5: a job of Sn runs only after the USER approved S(n-1) in the step bar (run.json), and the runner writes {DIR}stages/<Sn>/progress.json for the app's live progress. Agent steps (curate, trace, resolve, improve) are Claude's: it writes their files with library.write and reports to {DIR}stages/<Sn>/agent-progress.json. R2 data folders under steps/ keep their 0.3 names (S1_INTAKE, S2_BRIEF, S3_GEOMETRY, S4_RESOLVE, S5_COMPOSE, S7_3D). Placeholders: {CODE} {WORK} {PROJ} {STEPS} {OUT} {DIR} {SKILL} {ARG:x} {BASENAME:x} {REPO}. 0.5: the deck may be a moodboard IMAGE (S1_PANELS cuts Claude's panels.json into slides); S3 binds Python (object/2) objects and textured materials made by the Object Maker / Material Maker skills from the item crops; S4 embeds and bakes the Python objects.

S1_INTAKE.next: PPTX/PDF: the USER answers the questions in the Brief tab, then queue S1_DRAFT. IMAGE (deck.json needs_panels): AGENT marks the panels (Deck Reader read-an-image-deck.md) → write {STEPS}S1_INTAKE/panels.json (one board, or "boards" when the image holds several plans / moodboards), then queue S1_PANELS.
S1_INTAKE.title: Read the deck (PPTX, PDF or a moodboard IMAGE) and list the questions

S1_PANELS.title: Cut the image's panels into slides, file each crop under inputs/images/, list the questions
S1_PANELS.next: Every crop is now its own input: Projects/{CODE}/inputs/images/<source>/<board>/<category>/<id>.png (+ index.json). The USER answers the questions in the Brief tab (answers/main) — with several boards the first question picks the board. Then queue S1_DRAFT with { project, room } from their answer.

args.board: the board (floorplan) the user chose: questions.json room_ids[<answer>].board — only it is cropped

S1_DRAFT.next: AGENT: read the draft + the slide images, write roombrief.curated.json (typed params per item, zones, cameras, checks) to {STEPS}S2_BRIEF/roombrief.curated.json, then queue S2_FINALIZE. The user approves the Brief tab.
S1_DRAFT.title: Draft the room brief from the deck

S1_FINALIZE.next: The USER approves S1 Brief in the step bar. Then S2: trace the plan with the Floorplan Tracer (its own approvals), then queue S2_FROM_TRACER.
S1_FINALIZE.title: Check the curated brief covers every room slide

S2_FROM_TRACER.next: Plan tracing comes from the Floorplan Tracer (its S8 approved by the user). Queue S3_GEOMETRY next.
S2_FROM_TRACER.title: Walls, openings and the room outline from the Floorplan Tracer (its approved trace) → trace.px.json

args.tracer_code: the tracer project = this project's code (default)

S2_GEOMETRY.next: The user checks geometry_check.png (Plan tab) and approves.
S2_GEOMETRY.title: Walls, openings and zones from the traced plan

S3_CATALOG.next: AGENT: write resolve.json (item -> object + real param ids + host + materials) to {STEPS}S4_RESOLVE/resolve.json, then queue S4_CHECK.
S3_CATALOG.title: Snapshot the library's objects and materials

S3_CHECK.next: If review.todo.json lists items, Claude rebinds their params in resolve.json and re-queues S4_CHECK; then S5_COMPOSE.
S3_CHECK.title: Apply the user's Objects sign-off (if any), then check every item is bound to a real object, params and material

S4_PLACE.next: Open {OUT}{CODE}.room.canvas.json in the editor (Room tab) for the user to check, then queue S6_DRAWINGS.
S4_PLACE.title: Place every object on the room canvas

S5_3D.next: Show the user the snapshots (Room / Drawings tabs or the media/renders/ links); the model files are in output/3d/.
S5_3D.title: 3D model (.blend, .fbx, .glb) and snapshot images of the composed room (Blender on the runner)
